title: map_or(false, f) should be is_some_and(f) in relay_queue tests
description: relay_queue.rs tests use .map_or(false, |x| ...) in several filter expressions (e.g. lines 473, 511, 547). MSRV is 1.80 (from reader/Cargo.toml); is_some_and() was stabilized in 1.70. The idiomatic replacement is .is_some_and(|x| ...). clippy::map_unwrap_or flags this. Affects test code only but sets a bad pattern.
